question: During the battle between the Divine Dragon possessed by Al and Wilhelm, it seemed that Heinkel thought Wilhelm would win if things continued as they were, and so he interfered. If they had actually continued fighting as they were, did Wilhelm have a chance of winning? It was a battle that made me think, “If it's Wilhelm-san, perhaps he really could…”
answer:
Heinkel believes that Wilhelm-san is incredibly strong. He thinks something along the lines of, “There ain't anyone who could beat Wilhelm-san if they just fought him normally,” so Heinkel acted the way he did because he panicked.

That said, even as the writer, honestly, I couldn't picture Wilhelm-san in that state losing to Alcanica, so I had Heinkel interfere and put a damper on the fight. So I think the impression you got from reading it is correct.
